final_rationale: The verdict does not change because the Actor supplied no new admissible evidence and instead reframed the same evidence more narrowly. That reframing is substantively more accurate than a clean-certification claim: the current record supports general launch readiness and does not support any claim of full named-context evaluation coverage. But that narrower framing is not enough for compliant_with_caveats on the present record, because the key compliance predicate is not merely whether a caveated path could exist in principle; it is whether the certification record actually contains the required disclosure or conditional limitation. The available admissible evidence still does not show that the final certification text expressly discloses the allowable-cost explanation gap. So the unresolved concern from the initial report remains: a clean certification is unsupported, and a caveated certification may be supportable only if the required disclosure is actually present, which has not been shown here.
remaining_concerns: No new admissible evidence was provided; the Actor only narrowed the interpretation of the existing record.
The policy requires named deployment-context evaluation gaps to be disclosed or resolved before clean certification.
